name: Synthetic Engineering Undergraduate Scholarship Fund
restriction_text: Funds may only support undergraduate scholarships in the engineering school. Lab equipment is excluded.

name: Synthetic Engineering Lab Equipment Fund
restriction_text: Funds may only purchase lab equipment for the engineering school. Travel is excluded.

name: Synthetic Arts and Sciences Graduate TA Fund
restriction_text: Funds may only support graduate teaching assistants in the arts and sciences school.

name: Synthetic University Scholarship and TA Fund
restriction_text: Funds may only support scholarships or teaching assistant support for students of any level at any school.

name: Synthetic Engineering Donor Intent Fund
restriction_text: Support deserving engineering students and related educational activities, subject to donor intent.
